project.name: local-ai-chat-studio
project.description: A local-first AI chat studio that supports Ollama and optional bring-your-own-key providers, persistent conversations, retrieval, and personalized context.

nodes.name: Conversation Management
nodes.summary: Manages local conversation records, their ordered messages, and the active workspace conversation. It also supports conversation search, presets, and export through SQLite-backed persistence.

businessRules: Conversation records and messages are persisted locally in SQLite.
crossDomainInteractions: Supplies conversation messages to AI response generation.
Provides conversation history from which memory and personalization can be derived.

nodes.name: AI Response Generation
nodes.summary: Coordinates asynchronous model runs, including lifecycle state, emitted events, cancellation, provider streaming, and persistence. It exposes the API-backed path for generating chat responses.

businessRules: A run has explicit lifecycle states.
Run events and results are recorded while provider output is streamed.
crossDomainInteractions: Uses provider adapters to stream model output.
Records generated results against persisted conversation data.
Can be augmented by retrieval and personalized context in the Streamlit workspace.

nodes.name: Provider Access
nodes.summary: Configures local and hosted AI provider adapters, session-scoped credentials, and model discovery. It presents a common interface for Ollama and optional hosted providers while isolating discovery failures by provider.

businessRules: Credential values must not be empty after trimming.
Credentials are session-scoped with environment-backed fallback lookup.
Per-provider discovery errors are represented separately from successful discoveries.
crossDomainInteractions: Provides discovered models and streaming adapters to AI response generation.
Makes provider connection state available to workspace provider management.

nodes.name: Knowledge and Personalization
nodes.summary: Turns uploaded documents, chat history, and durable memories into locally managed retrieval context. It extracts user memories and maintains vector-backed semantic recall alongside SQLite persistence.

businessRules: Uploaded text is chunked before it is indexed for retrieval.
Memories can be extracted from conversations, persisted, indexed, and decayed.
crossDomainInteractions: Uses conversation content as a source for memory extraction.
Provides retrieved document and memory context to the chat workspace and generation workflow.

nodes.name: Conversation Lifecycle
nodes.summary: Establishes local conversation storage, creates or selects a conversation, and retrieves its ordered messages for the workspace.

nodes.name: Conversation Export
nodes.summary: Collects a persisted conversation and its messages, then produces a portable conversation export.

nodes.name: Stream Chat Run
nodes.summary: Validates a model-run request and manages its asynchronous execution, events, provider stream, and stored result.

nodes.name: Provider Configuration and Discovery
nodes.summary: Builds the configured provider set, accepts session credentials, and discovers the models available through each provider.

nodes.name: Document Retrieval Indexing
nodes.summary: Parses an uploaded document, splits its text into chunks, indexes the chunks, and makes matching content searchable.

nodes.name: Memory Extraction and Recall
nodes.summary: Extracts memories from conversation activity, persists and indexes them, then retrieves relevant memories for later context.

nodes.name: Initialize Local Storage
nodes.summary: Initializes the SQLite database used by chat workspace persistence.

nodes.name: Create Conversation
nodes.summary: Creates a persisted conversation record for the workspace.

nodes.name: Switch Active Conversation
nodes.summary: Changes the conversation selected by the Streamlit workspace.

nodes.name: Load Ordered Messages
nodes.summary: Retrieves the persisted messages for the selected conversation.

nodes.name: Load Conversation
nodes.summary: Retrieves the conversation record selected for export.

nodes.name: Load Conversation Messages
nodes.summary: Reads the persisted messages that belong to the conversation export.

nodes.name: Render Markdown Export
nodes.summary: Exports a conversation in Markdown format.

nodes.name: Validate Run Request
nodes.summary: Validates the messages and generation settings used to begin a model run.

nodes.name: Create Run State
nodes.summary: Holds mutable run state, emitted events, and synchronization primitives for one run.

nodes.name: Execute Provider Stream
nodes.summary: Creates and executes an asynchronous provider run while supporting streaming and cancellation.

nodes.name: Record Run Result
nodes.summary: Records streamed run results in storage as part of run management.

nodes.name: Build Provider Registry
nodes.summary: Builds the configured collection of local and hosted provider adapters.

nodes.name: Validate Provider Credential
nodes.summary: Rejects a provider credential when it is empty after trimming.

nodes.name: Store Session Credential
nodes.summary: Maintains thread-safe provider credentials for an individual session with environment-backed fallback lookup.

nodes.name: Discover Provider Models
nodes.summary: Indexes adapters and concurrently discovers models while isolating provider-specific failures.

nodes.name: Parse Upload
nodes.summary: Parses an uploaded attachment into text suitable for downstream processing.

nodes.name: Chunk Document Text
nodes.summary: Splits parsed document text into retrieval-ready chunks.

nodes.name: Index Document Chunks
nodes.summary: Stores document chunks in the vector retrieval layer.

nodes.name: Search Indexed Documents
nodes.summary: Queries indexed document vectors for relevant document content.

nodes.name: Check Memory Extraction
nodes.summary: Coordinates whether memories should be extracted during the chat workspace workflow.

nodes.name: Extract Memories
nodes.summary: Derives memories from conversation content for persistent personalization.

nodes.name: Persist Memory
nodes.summary: Adds a memory record to the chat workspace persistence layer.

nodes.name: Index Memory
nodes.summary: Indexes a memory in the vector retrieval store.

nodes.name: Retrieve Relevant Memories
nodes.summary: Selects memories relevant to the current conversation context.

edges.description: Persisted conversation messages provide the chat context used to create model runs.
Provider adapters and discovered models enable model-run streaming.
Conversation activity supplies the source material for memory extraction and chat-history recall.
Retrieved documents and memories augment the chat workspace context used for generation.
